description: This Java source file defines the RunTestEvents class, which provides a method to execute JUnit tests within the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles HTTP requests to start test runs, constructing startup commands and managing the test container lifecycle.

classes.name: RunTestEvents
classes.description: Contains a static method to run a JUnit test suite in response to an HTTP request.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: Handles an HTTP request to initiate a JUnit test run by configuring startup commands, initializing a test container, and returning the success or error status.
